replies.author: OPTOBAT
replies.body:
My Top 10:
#1 Quintus - Lots of strategy and plenty of monuments.
#2 Rendezvous 3 - Basic structured map and good teamwork 
#3 Senex - Basic map with fire bows i think?
#4 Rendezvous - Original map, with good design and excellent teamwork
#5 Decay - Lasts a while, awesome team work, archery, everyones equal for PVP. 
#6 Venomous - Underrated in my opinion, save up gold, good defence map.
#7 Wonderland - Awesome defence map, strategy, pretty good for rushing.
=7 Unix - Another good defence map, grouped PVP, teamwork, okay rushing.
#8 Sandstorm - Underrated, diamonds!, amazing rushing map, good to defend to.
#9 Justice 2 - Good design, good for defence, team work
#10 Teres - Diamonds, okay for rushing, strategy, be powerful.
=10 Fissura - Original for a newish map, RUSHING, okay for defence.
=10 Ternio - Probably could be higher on list, good for sky bridge and defence, nice team work, and it tends to last a while..


You may disagree but whatever, everyone has an opinion :)
